Clara (Marketing): Heads-up - sales reported 14 inbound leads unassigned overnight. sharing quick timeline.
Dev (Sales Ops): timeframe and severity?
Clara (Marketing): 2026-03-24 23:40026-03-25 00:05 UTC. 14 total, 5 >120s unassigned. HS webhook latency spike; enrichment P95 ~12s.
Ming (Eng): quick mitigation proposal: enrichment_timeout=8000ms, partial_route=true, overflow_after=60000ms, reduce batch wait for HS path to 50ms. also emit lead_route.outcome metric.
Rory (Support): please tag partial routes with missing_enrich=true so SDRs can filter and follow up.
Dev (Sales Ops): suggest HS webhook TTL=10000ms and retries=3 to avoid long-lived retry storms.
Ming (Eng): I'll open a PR for config changes and add the metric. aim to deploy a 5% canary within 24h.
Clara (Marketing): Canary plan: 5% traffic, 24h monitor. success criteria: assign P95 < 40s and unassigned_count drop >80%.
leadwatch-bot: Alert INC-2026-130 created: 14 unassigned leads >120s; enrichment P95=12s.
Clara (Marketing): Action items: Dev - update HS settings; Ming - PR + deploy canary; Rory - add support saved search for missing_enrich; Clara - run canary and report. Post updates here.
